content.short: SPO JAPAN GUILD supports Japanese Stake Pool Operators and promotes Cardano decentralization in Japan.
content.description: SPO JAPAN GUILD is a community-focused initiative dedicated to supporting Japanese Stake Pool Operators (SPOs) within the Cardano ecosystem. By providing technical resources, node update manuals, and weekly meetings in Japanese, the guild helps overcome language barriers and empowers local participants to secure the network. The project fosters collaboration through a dedicated hub where operators share technical verification results and best practices. By strengthening the Japanese-speaking community, SPO JAPAN GUILD plays a vital role in diversifying network decentralization.
